overview.oneLineTake: AI-fueled index records are masking Fed hawkishness, an energy supply shock, and deteriorating market breadth, creating a fragile rally vulnerable to sudden volatility expansion.
themes: AI euphoria drives narrow tech leadership to extremes (Meta Muse surge, AMD $1T market cap, Nasdaq record closes)
Fed maintains hawkish stance with officials signaling more hikes may be needed despite softening housing and manufacturing data
Energy supply shock accelerates as diesel hits record highs above $6.50 and Middle East tensions disrupt Saudi shipping routes
U.S.-China engage in high-stakes diplomacy on trade and AI governance ahead of Trump-Xi summit
risks: Extreme market concentration and deteriorating breadth beneath headline index records (1999 analogies resurfacing)
Fed overtightening into clear cyclical weakness (housing starts down, manufacturing dropping, industrial production flat)
Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East (Iran tensions, Houthi strikes) and potential U.S. diesel export ban rhetoric
